id: title:Gilbert09:stop dropped connection retries reporting error tracking noise

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and alert suppression for transient connection failures in Notion warehouse connector.
review.reason: Adds a production marker and corresponding test to distinguish transient, self-recovering connection errors from permanent exceptions in warehouse ingestion. This preserves ingestion reliability and avoids unnecessary alerting or backoff for transient failures.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunk observations; no independent verification of actual production behavior or alert suppression. Tier 2 assigned because implementation and test are present and consistent, supporting a bounded correctness improvement, but broader systemic impact or actual incident avoidance is not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a production implementation change. P1.F2.H1 is a test change. The implementation and test are consistent, supporting a single change group. No other hunks are supplied, so no cross-PR or unrelated-PR uncertainty exists.

observations.behavior: Adds a new retryable marker to the set of transient, self-recovering errors. The marker is the string returned by urllib3's MaxRetryError when the underlying connection is dropped or reset after tenacity's internal retries are exhausted.
observations.code_quote: return {"Notion API error (retryable)", "Notion rate limited", "Max retries exceeded with url"}
observations.posthog_connection: This marker allows the PostHog warehouse ingestion worker to distinguish transient, self-recovering failures from permanent exceptions. When the marker matches, the worker does not record the failure as a tracked exception, preserving the reliability of the warehouse ingestion and avoiding unnecessary alerting or backoff.
